title: NCERT Figure 6.32(a) - a girl on a swivel chair demonstrating conservation of angular momentum; only the vertical axis she spins about and the sense of that spin are redrawn.
unreadable: the whole drawing: a freehand pen sketch of a girl seated on a swivel chair, with her arms drawn SOLID close to the body and DASHED stretched out - the two arm positions are the entire physical content of the figure and there is no primitive here that draws a person
the floor shading and the chair's castors
note: This figure is a freehand illustration and belongs to the undrawable class. Only two things in it are geometry: the vertical dashed axis the chair turns about, and the curved arrow over her head giving the sense of the turn - that arrow is an arc plus a straight head along the arc's tangent at its end angle. The redraw is therefore almost empty on purpose; the card should keep showing the scan, because the solid-versus-dashed arms are what the question turns on.
